title: Hospitals and ambulances
summary: Find information and services related to NSW hospitals, including urgent care, parking, and checking hospital performance, as well as details on ambulance fees and transport.

faqs.q: Where can I go for treatment if my illness or injury is not an emergency?
faqs.a: You can access Urgent Care Services for treatment of an injury or illness that is not an emergency.

faqs.q: How can I check the wait times for a major NSW hospital emergency department?
faqs.a: You can check the wait times for major NSW hospital emergency departments.

faqs.q: What services are available regarding NSW ambulance fees?
faqs.a: You can pay your NSW ambulance fee, claim an exemption, or access the Patient Transport Service (PTS).
